title: Concept: Authentication method reported as none
description: An authMethod field set to none on a protected resource in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A response that labels the session as unauthenticated while still returning account data means the route is reachable without a credential.
applicability: Deployments that render an authMethod field set to none on a protected resource into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A response that labels the session as unauthenticated while still returning account data means the route is reachable without a credential.
